hardware.gpu: 8 x NVIDIA L4 (SM89), no cross-NUMA peer access
hardware.cpu: Intel(R) Xeon(R) CPU @ 2.20GHz; 96 logical CPUs, two NUMA nodes

method.bytes: complete input/rank for AR/RS; complete output/rank for AG
method.point: median of two sweep medians; each sweep is median of 5 repeat medians, each repeat median of 20 calls
method.timer: slowest-rank eager CUDA events, including host submission gaps

validation.compute_processes: checked before and after every sweep; occupied GPU aborts

limits: Measurements are standalone dense eager calls; parallel submission reserves eight CPU threads and spins up to 2 ms.
No application or multiprocess speedup established; options require exact local calibration.
GPU arithmetic and CPU hierarchical rounding differ.
Sizes above 4 MiB use historical measurements in the overview figures and were not remeasured here.
